title: Lived experience, not hype, powered Agusan’s 2026 Palaro hosting

blocks.text: PROSPERIDAD, Agusan del Sur — Groundwork, genuine hospitality and community ownership—rather than mere publicity—powered Agusan del Sur’s successful hosting of the 2026 Palarong Pambansa, an official said. Speaking at the launch of the Public Relations Society of the Philippines (PRSP) Mindanao Regional Network and the “Maki+Fiesta” media festival on Thursday, provincial tourism officer Dannah Rufalyn Buquir said the landlocked province turned national unfamiliarity and logistical doubts into a showcase for roughly 20,000 athletes, coaches, officials and visitors. When Agusan del Sur won the hosting bid in 2024, Buquir recalled facing skepticism about its infrastructure readiness and limited name recall outside Mindanao. […]...
